reply: ual is structured in t and not in A, so the A-dependence looks right and the gap is in S(t). The shape of S(t) (rises to a peak near t≈1.7, then decays) did not match any simple exponential/1/t family I tried. The last candidate was the best, and its t-part has no clean closed form I'd stand behind.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    S = params[0]*np.exp(-params[1]*t) + params[2]*t*np.exp(-params[3]*t) + params[4]*np.exp(-params[5]*t)/t + params[6] + params[8]*t*np.exp(-params[9]*t*t)
    return S - params[7]*t**2*A**1.5
